title: Streets of Rage 4
notes: While I only tested out booting, opening every menu and making sure I got in-game, this is not too demanding a game (so 1080p 60fps) and it looks good at first glance (can't wait to play!) 👊🏼 I did manage to make it crash picking the "Extras" menu item but after relaunching, I was able to get into Extras (it's a gallery) just fine 🤷🏼‍♂️ It looks like net play works - I saw an online game to join but didn't nab it in time (game is 6 years old so don't expect many peeps out there!)
